en: A black‑and‑white street scene showing a European city around the early 20th century. The view looks down a cobblestone street lined with four‑ to five‑story masonry buildings, many with ornate window frames and dormer roofs. On the right side are shopfronts with awnings, including one with large display windows and signage above. Several pedestrians, including children and women in long skirts and hats, walk along the street. Horse‑drawn vehicles are absent, and there are no automobiles visible. The overall composition and framing resemble a historic postcard photograph.
